case_number: 2025 INSC 306; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (Crl.) NO. 1959 OF 2022)
summary: Factory definition vs service activity; 'manufacturing process' under Factories Act, 1948 s.2(k) includes washing/cleaning with view to use/sale; transformation not required for commercial marketability; High Court erred in quashing summons for lack of application of mind; inspection revealed 9+ workers, power-assisted process, no licence; ESIC coverage supports factory status; prima facie case established.
legal_provisions_cited: Goa Factories Rules, 1985 Rule 3, Rule 4, Rule 6
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment quashing summons set aside; criminal proceedings under Section 92 of the Factories Act, 1948 reinstated.
